blogs.title: How to Crack Competitive Exams with 60 Days of Timed Mock Practice
blogs.author: Result Darpan Team
blogs.summary: Discover the 3-phase revision framework that helped thousands of aspirants improve their test scores from 50% to 85%+.
blogs.content:
Preparing for national competitive exams like SSC, Banking, Railways, or State PSC requires more than just reading books. High scorers separate themselves through targeted mock practice.

### 1. The Error Log Habit
Never complete a mock test without analyzing every incorrect answer. Write down why you missed it: was it a conceptual gap, a calculation error, or poor time management?

### 2. Time-per-Question Rule
In exams like SSC CGL or Banking Prelims, spending more than 60 seconds on any single reasoning question can derail your entire section. Practice skipping smartly.

### 3. Subject-wise Weak Spot Drills
Use Result Darpan's topic tests to isolate and drill weak areas. If geometry is hurting your quant score, spend 3 days doing only geometry sets before taking another full mock.

blogs.title: Last Month Revision Roadmap for General Awareness & Static GK
blogs.author: Result Darpan Team
blogs.summary: A high-yield checklist covering Indian Polity articles, Modern History timelines, and the top current affairs topics for upcoming tests.
blogs.content:
General Awareness is the biggest score multiplier because questions take less than 15 seconds to answer.

### High-Yield Static GK Topics
- **Indian Polity:** Fundamental Rights (Articles 12-35), Directive Principles, President & Governor powers, Constitutional Amendments.
- **Geography:** Major river systems, National Parks, Biosphere reserves, Mountain passes.
- **History:** 1857 Revolt to 1947 Independence movement landmarks, Governor Generals, Congress sessions.

### Monthly Current Affairs Strategy
Focus on the last 6 months of awards, summit locations, sports championships, and government schemes.

blogs.title: Quantitative Aptitude: 10 Speed Math Shortcuts Every Aspirant Must Memorize
blogs.author: Result Darpan Team
blogs.summary: Stop solving with pencil-and-paper long division. Learn fast percentage-to-fraction conversions, digital sums, and LCM unit methods.
blogs.content:
In competitive exams, quant is not a test of knowledge; it is a test of calculation velocity.

### 1. Fractional Percentages
- 1/6 = 16.66%
- 1/7 = 14.28%
- 1/8 = 12.5%
- 1/9 = 11.11%
- 1/11 = 9.09%
- 1/12 = 8.33%

Converting 37.5% into 3/8 instantaneously turns complicated calculations into mental arithmetic.

### 2. Time & Work: LCM Unit Method
Avoid 1/A + 1/B fractions. Find the LCM of the days to define total work units. Calculate individual daily efficiency and sum them up. Works cleanly for pipes, cisterns, and negative work leakages.

### 3. CI vs SI Difference Shortcut
For 2 years: Difference = P × (R/100)².
For 3 years: Difference = P × (R/100)² × [3 + (R/100)].
Saves over 90 seconds on every compound interest question!

blogs.title: Mastering Logical Reasoning: How to Solve Syllogisms and Puzzles in Record Time
blogs.author: Result Darpan Team
blogs.summary: A foolproof Venn diagram and 100-50 approach to solve complex syllogisms, coded inequalities, and seating arrangements.
blogs.content:
Logical Reasoning is often the highest scoring section if you avoid common cognitive traps.

### 1. Venn Diagrams for 'Only a Few'
'Only a few A are B' means two definite statements: Some A are B AND Some A are NOT B. Remembering both conditions eliminates 95% of deduction traps in modern exam patterns.

### 2. EJOTY Alphabet Trick
Remember letter positions in multiples of 5: E(5), J(10), O(15), T(20), Y(25). Combine with reverse letter pairs (A-Z, B-Y, C-X, D-W, E-V, etc.) using mnemonic 'AZad, BoY, CruX, DeW, EVen'.

### 3. Linear & Circular Seating Strategy
Always begin with the absolute, fixed condition rather than conditional ones. Create 2 parallel case threads rather than erasing pencil marks.
